project_type: t-bench debugging task for distributed consensus ledger verification
build_system: none - stdlib only Python, runs via python3 -m runtime.pipeline
build_command: python3 -m runtime.pipeline (in /app context, or locally in consensus-ledger-repair/environment/)
test_command: cd consensus-ledger-repair/environment && python3 -m runtime.pipeline && cd ../.. && python3 -m pytest consensus-ledger-repair/tests/test_consensus_ledger.py -v
verification_instructions: 1. Run pipeline locally to generate output. 2. Run repair script. 3. Run pipeline again. 4. Run pytest to confirm all tests pass after repair.
setup_instructions: No external dependencies needed - stdlib only Python 3.11
environment_constraints: All Python code uses stdlib only (hashlib, json, os, configparser, math). Docker image is ghcr.io/laude-institute/t-bench/python-3.11-uv:latest.
contribution_requirements: Every file must contain PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY as a comment. All paths in instruction.md must be absolute (/app/runtime/...). No comments hinting at bugs. Include misleading comments that make bugs look intentional.
key_patterns: Follows t-bench task pattern: environment/Dockerfile + environment/runtime/ for the buggy code, solution/ for repair script, tests/ for validation, instruction.md for task description, task.toml for metadata. Pipeline produces JSON output that tests validate. Repair script uses string replacements to fix bugs then re-runs pipeline.
directory_structure: consensus-ledger-repair/ contains environment/ (Dockerfile + runtime/ with Python modules and data/), solution/ (repair script), tests/ (test.sh + pytest file), instruction.md, task.toml
